title: Node suppresses terminal LinkLayer receipt-clock failure
description: Security codereview finding across python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py and python/src/lichen/node.py: LinkLayer._receipt_now permanently sets _receipt_clock_failed after monotonic regression/reentry and every later receive path raises RuntimeError, but Node._receive_loop catches generic Exception, logs it, and continues as though recoverable. The node remains RUNNING while authenticated ingress is permanently unavailable and may repeatedly poll/log forever. Introduce a distinct terminal link-security clock exception (or terminal LinkLayer failure state), surface it like LinkPersistenceError so Node startup/background-task monitoring observes failure, and test first regression plus subsequent receive-loop termination.
